name: final-speed-prefill

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: cold prefill 8K/32K/128K/224K: 3 kept passes each, every pass answered
bench all prefill phase: cold 32K, 128K, 224K replies equal to the pinned replies (PASS pin)

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench prefill-sweep   (cold 8K, 32K, 128K, 224K; a unique prompt every pass; 4 passes, the first discarded; 128 tokens decoded after)
./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (prefill phase: cold 32K, 128K, 224K compared with the pinned replies)
notes: Cold prefill over a unique prompt per pass (prefix cache off for the request), median of the 3 kept passes; drafter dspark booted (shipping defaults), GPU capped at 2,200 MHz. prefill_*_bench_all_tok_s are the single-pass figures of bench all's prefill phase on the same boot.
